The '''First Responder medpac''' was a model of [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]] produced by [[Athakam Medtech/Legends|Athakam Medtech]] and available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The medpac carried instruments for emergency field surgery, a [[Medical diagnostic computer|diagnostic computer]], a [[Medical scanner/Legends|medscanner]], advanced [[Synthe-nutrient replicator/Legends|synthe-nutrient replicator]]s, [[Spray splint/Legends|spray splints]] and drugs to counter radiation and biological poisons. A single First Responder cost 400 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="EOTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The First Responder medpac was created for the ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying game [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Core Rulebook'']] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2013]].
